ns2:section.sectionText: This seminar will explore the psychological construct of interest and its relationship to motivation, engagement, and learning. Topics will include defining and assessing interest, biological underpinnings of interest, interest development over time, promoting and sustaining interest, the history of research on interest, and the nature of interest-triggering experiences. Different approaches to interest research will be considered and discussed. Students in the course will read historical and current papers, and engage in the class by writing paper summaries, reviews, and position statements on medium.com, as well producing a course project that can be a focused literature review, technology development project, or small research study on interest.
